# annals

> Annals for AI agents: publish markdown, html, images, video, audio, PDFs and folders to a private page the owner reads on the phone, and get back a link.


## Pages

- [annals](index.html.md): Annals for AI agents. An agent publishes a document (markdown, html, an image, a video, a PDF, or a ...
- [API reference](api.html.md): | &#96;annals&#96;   | annals: an in-tray for AI agents.   |
- [annals](_autosummary/annals.html.md): annals: an in-tray for AI agents. Publish documents and media to a private page; get a link.
- [annals.aggregate](_autosummary/annals.aggregate.html.md): Many markdown files as ONE markdown document: a title, a table of contents, a section per file.
- [annals.auth](_autosummary/annals.auth.html.md): The auth seam: who may read the annals.
- [annals.catalog](_autosummary/annals.catalog.html.md): The catalog: every source’s items as one list, with search and the owner’s tags.
- [annals.combine](_autosummary/annals.combine.html.md): Many files of many kinds as ONE document: a Markdown, html or PDF file.
- [annals.config](_autosummary/annals.config.html.md): Settings: where documents are published and what link to print.
- [annals.jsonstore](_autosummary/annals.jsonstore.html.md): A &#96;MutableMapping&#96; kept in one JSON file, safe with several server processes.
- [annals.linkcheck](_autosummary/annals.linkcheck.html.md): Find what a document mentions without linking to it: the owner reads on a phone and clicks through.
- [annals.listening](_autosummary/annals.listening.html.md): What each reader has heard of each audio document: percent heard, listens, where they stopped.
- [annals.mcp](_autosummary/annals.mcp.html.md): MCP surface: the same operations as the CLI, from &#96;annals.tools&#96;, via &#96;py2mcp&#96;.
- [annals.media](_autosummary/annals.media.html.md): The media relay for published html pages: what a framed page plays, told to the page around it.
- [annals.notebook](_autosummary/annals.notebook.html.md): A share’s documents as separate notebook sources: one plain web page per text file.
- [annals.overview](_autosummary/annals.overview.html.md): Spoken overviews of a document: the request a page makes, and the worker that fulfils it.
- [annals.references](_autosummary/annals.references.html.md): The references of documents, extracted and combined, in three forms.
- [annals.render](_autosummary/annals.render.html.md): Render markdown (and other page-like files) to html and PDF, with their images inside.
- [annals.requirements](_autosummary/annals.requirements.html.md): Optional dependencies, checked where they are needed and explained when they are missing.
- [annals.share](_autosummary/annals.share.html.md): Share links: one document (or a group) behind a public, unguessable, revocable link.
- [annals.sources](_autosummary/annals.sources.html.md): Item sources: everything the page lists, wherever it lives, as rows of one shape.
- [annals.store](_autosummary/annals.store.html.md): The document store: a flat set of documents, tags, groups and a recycle bin, as plain files.
- [annals.tables](_autosummary/annals.tables.html.md): Scrolling, zooming tables for published html pages.
- [annals.tags](_autosummary/annals.tags.html.md): The owner’s tags: a &#96;MutableMapping&#96; from item key to tag list, kept apart from the items.
- [annals.target](_autosummary/annals.target.html.md): The transport seam: a document tree lands in a directory, here or on another machine.
- [annals.tools](_autosummary/annals.tools.html.md): The operations, as plain functions: JSON-able arguments in, JSON-able dicts out.
- [For AI agents](ai-agents.html.md): &#96;annals&#96; ships artifacts for coding agents alongside its code. This page lists
